proposed_fixes.title: MWB screen-edge switching intermittently needs desktop interaction
proposed_fixes.root_cause: A fullscreen/shell-window classification or input-hook state may suppress edge crossing while Explorer or another desktop surface is active.
plan: Compare edge-crossing eligibility and fullscreen/shell classification for desktop, taskbar, and ordinary windows.
Correct classification or reset edge-crossing state for the failing desktop surface without requiring a click.
Add a focused test for intermittent edge crossing while Explorer is foreground.
verification: Repeat edge crossing on both PCs with Explorer foreground and confirm transfer occurs without clicking or opening Start.

comment.body: Thanks for the detailed steps and supplied bugreport. Another user found that ignoring `explorer.exe` fixed a similar desktop-only edge block, and you noted the behavior had eased. Could you confirm the current PowerToys version on both PCs and whether that specific workaround changes your reproduction? This tests the shell-classification hypothesis without asking you to repeat diagnostics already supplied.
